purpose: Original conceptual artwork for NexPixels. Not client deliverables or photographs of the studio.

prompts.hero: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: premium wide website hero for NexPixels, a Dubai custom web development and digital product studio. Create an original photorealistic 3D editorial still life representing custom-built websites and interconnected business applications. A beautiful monumental curved ribbon of smoked glass and brushed dark graphite, with three precisely layered translucent browser-like architectural panes emerging from a pale limestone plinth. The panes contain only sparse abstract wireframe geometry, tiny unlabeled controls and fine connector lines, never readable interface text. One slender luminous signal-green edge (#00F076), deeper forest-green reflections, obsidian (#0A0A0A) and warm ivory (#F7F7F5). Luxury industrial design, physically plausible materials, tactile frosted glass, refined studio lighting, soft cinematic shadows and subtle grain. Wide 16:9 landscape composition, subject centered with generous breathing room, all important forms inside central 75 percent for responsive cropping. Quiet confidence, architectural rather than sci-fi, crisp and exceptionally polished. No text, letters, numbers, logos, people, robot, city skyline, watermark, blue, purple, generic stock-photo symbols or excessive glow. One cohesive full-bleed scene; no collage. Render as high-quality production website artwork.
prompts.interface-design: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original premium editorial illustration for a custom web studio's UI/UX design section. Create a photorealistic architectural product still life: three upright frosted glass panels at different precise offsets on an ivory limestone surface, the central panel slightly forward. Abstract refined website wireframe compositions engraved into the glass: tasteful rectangular image areas, small unlabeled circles and thin horizontal rules. A single green glass vertical tab and one hairline signal-green accent (#00F076). Obsidian graphite frames, deep forest green reflections, warm off-white (#F7F7F5) studio backdrop. Restrained premium industrial design, tactile materials, soft directional daylight, sophisticated shadows, subtle film grain, exquisite bevels and realistic glass refraction. Landscape 3:2 composition, centered sculpture with generous negative space, object fits entirely within central 80 percent. This is conceptual design artwork, not a real project or software screenshot. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, people, hands, blue, purple, neon sci-fi effects or collage.
prompts.connected-applications: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original premium editorial illustration for custom web application development and business integrations. A sculptural assembly of five perfectly machined dark graphite modules on a low warm limestone plinth, connected by elegant transparent glass channels with a restrained glowing signal-green filament (#00F076) inside. A larger smoked-glass architectural arch joins two of the modules, symbolizing a purpose-built business workflow. Impeccable object design and precision engineering, no circuit-board clichés. Palette obsidian (#0A0A0A), deep forest green, warm off-white (#F7F7F5). Photorealistic premium 3D product photography, tactile stone, brushed graphite, thick glass, delicate green reflections, generous softbox lighting, soft cinematic shadow and subtle grain. Landscape 3:2 composition, centered object within central 80 percent, clean ivory background with breathing room. This is abstract concept art, not a real client product. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, people, blue, purple, excessive glow, robots or collage.
